title: With more than 8 options the Customer chip offers search
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, owned by customer A, with nine work orders at the test location: one for customer A billing itself and eight for customer A, each billed to a different new payer, so the chip has 9 options.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
  3. Type the first word of one payer's name in Search customers.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • 9 rows are listed.

Step 2:

  • The chip shows a "Search customers" box above its 9 options.

Step 3:

  • Only the payers whose names match are listed.
